description: This file defines the 'Filter' controller class for the Opencart admin panel's catalog section. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and autocomplete for product filters, including rendering views and handling user permissions.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing product filters in the admin catalog section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point; loads filter list view with header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Triggers loading of filter list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filter groups with pagination, sorting, and renders filter list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a filter group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding or editing) a filter group, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filter groups, with permission and dependency checks.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete data for filters based on a filter name prefix.
